description: Delivery lifecycle of one parcel as the booking conversation sees it — never the carrier's own internal state.

requested.description: The orchestrator has asked for a parcel to be taken; no carrier has committed yet.

CARRIER_ACCEPTED.description: A carrier issued a label. The first commitment anyone has made.

CARRIER_REFUSED.guard: an untried carrier remains within the retry budget
CARRIER_REFUSED.description: Self-transition — the retry is the same request against the next carrier.

booked.description: A carrier holds a label and a collection slot; the parcel is still on acme's premises.

PARCEL_SCANNED.description: First scan. Custody has passed and the booking is no longer cancellable.

COLLECTION_MISSED.guard: within the carrier's collection retry window

CANCEL_BOOKING.description: Cancellation is only available before custody passes; afterwards it is a return.

in-transit.description: The parcel is in the carrier's custody and moving. Acme observes and cannot intervene.

DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_FAILED.guard: attempts remaining under the carrier's own policy
DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_FAILED.description: Attempt counting is the carrier's; acme mirrors it and never decides it.

ADDRESS_UNDELIVERABLE.description: The address does not resolve on the ground, whatever the schema accepted.

delivered.description: A courier recorded a handover. Terminal — a later return is a new conversation.

returned.description: The parcel is coming back. The refund that may follow belongs to billing, not here.

failed.description: No carrier took it, or it never arrived. A human owns it; the order stays paid.
